node.title: Re^5: LibXML setNodeName error
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
So you have something like ? That's not going to be valid as an [https://www.w3.org/TR/xml/#sec-starttags|XML element Name] (?), so what do you want the element to be named instead in that case?

It's not an issue with [mod://XML::LibXML], which probably follows the XML spec precisely, but with XML itself. Also, as always, [id://1177642|SSCCE] - give us the shortest possible code that demonstrates the problem so we can see it.
